event_summary: A small brown round object moves across a wooden tabletop from left to right while a white rectangular block and a black side object remain stationary.
raw_event_description: The video begins with a wooden tabletop, a white textured rectangular block near the back center, and a dark cylindrical object partly visible at the left edge. After a still interval, a small brown round object appears from the left side of the table, travels rightward across the open tabletop in front of and below the white block, shows motion blur and changing visible orientation, then exits the right edge. The scene remains still afterward.

reasons: The tabletop and stationary objects are visible before the moving brown object appears.
The white block is unobstructed near the back center.
The left-edge dark object is only partly within the frame.
